title: SportsLiveInfo feed manifest (v1/manifest.json)
description: Entry point for read-only B1G clients. Readers MUST ignore unknown fields, unknown assets and unknown capabilities, and MUST refuse a format_major they do not support (keeping their last good feed).

live_state_rule.description: 1.6+: when status_normalized 'live' may be shown as LIVE

live_overlay_rule.description: 1.6+: how the optional live asset overlays the day assets

tier_rule.description: 1.6+: which assets carry core and extra events

link_order.description: 0.3.24+: broadcast_links are published best first; readers keep the order

link_rule.description: 0.3.24+: how readers use link order and binds

binds_rule.description: S2, optional: the rule that produced each link's binds (narrow = default; legacy = the 0.3.24 kill switch). Informational: readers use binds as published

live_until_rule.description: 0.3.24+: readers show LIVE while start_utc <= now < live_until_utc

live_max_age_minutes.description: 0.3.24+: observation age limit used by live_state_rule, for readers without live_until_utc

live_end_grace_minutes.description: 0.3.24+: minutes after expected_end_utc that live_state_rule still trusts 'live'

display_state_rule.description: Contract 4.5: how display_state, state_until_utc and finished_at_utc are decided and how a reader past state_until_utc re-applies them

history_rule.description: Contract 4.5: window.history_from and the optional events:<history_from> asset

time_precision_rule.description: Contract 4.5: date_only and time_tbc starts are 00:00 Europe/London, never a clock time

starting_soon_minutes.description: Contract 4.5: display_state starting_soon begins this many minutes before start_utc

scores.description: 1.7+, present only while at least one source is approved for scores (kill switch: absent means scores are off and readers must show none)

rule.description: How readers pair and show scores

standings.description: Optional, present only while standings assets are published (capability standings; kill switch: absent means readers show no feed standings)

rule.description: How readers use the standings assets

history_from.description: Contract 4.5, optional: the Europe/London day before window.from; the optional asset events:<history_from> carries that day. Absent: no history

live_stale_after_minutes.description: 1.6, optional: a 'live' status older than this is never shown as LIVE

live_lane.description: 1.6, optional: the live-status lane. interval_minutes applies only while events are in play.

kind.description: taxonomy | channels | identity | dictionary | guide_map | events:YYYY-MM-DD | events:<history_from> (optional, required false, previous London day, contract 4.6) | events_extra:YYYY-MM-DD (1.6, optional, tier extra) | today | live (1.6, optional, sli.live/1) | standings:<competition_id> (optional, sli.standings/1, capability standings) | health | (future kinds: ignore)

history.description: Contract 4.5, optional: true on the events:<history_from> asset

scores.description: 1.7+, present only while a source is approved for scores: the owner-approved score sources (config score_approvals)

standings.description: Optional (capability standings), present only while standings assets are published: master switch, maximum table age and the attribution of every source used

crests.description: Optional (capability team_crests). Master kill switch: crests can be switched off centrally without a TV update. References only, never images.

featured_competition_ids.description: Optional (metadata release): taxonomy competition ids SportsLiveInfo asks readers to feature.

featured_event_count.description: Optional: how many ids today.featured_event_ids holds at most.

sport_order.description: Optional: default order of b1g_priority_group values; the same list as taxonomy default_sport_order. The user's own order overrides it.

ranking.description: Optional: {field: 'feature_rank', rule: the exact scoring rule}.
